card.name: Linking words before example drug lists
card.fires_on: Small linking words or punctuation such as "such as", "including", "e.g.," and "and" that come right before a list of example drugs or drug classes in a drug interaction section.

modes.label: such as
modes.description: The word "as" after "such" introduces named interacting drugs or classes.

modes.label: including
modes.description: The word "including" opens a list of drugs that affect another drug's action.
modes.example: may be potentiated by certain drugs,<< including>> nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory agents and other

modes.label: punctuation or and
modes.description: A comma, "e.g.," or "and" directly before a drug name in an interaction passage.

card.plain: It marks the spot in interaction text where a list of example drugs is about to begin.
